ValidationRule.description: Restricts invalid Job Status transitions by enforcing the approved Job Requirement lifecycle. Valid transitions are: New → Open, Open → On Hold/Closed, On Hold → Open/Closed. Reopening a Closed Job Requirement (Closed → Open) is permitted only for admins
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Job Status transition. Allowed transitions are: New → Open, Open → On Hold or Closed, and On Hold → Open or Closed. Only System Administrators can reopen a Closed Job Requirement.
